These are synthetic, anonymous HTML examples of Moodle 4.x markup, not captured
student pages. They cover the structures documented in Moodle's upstream
`core_course/activity_info`, `core_course/activity_date`, `mod_assign/output/renderer`,
`mod_quiz/attempt_summary_information`, `mod/quiz/classes/output/renderer.php`,
`grade/report/user/classes/report/user.php`, `grade/report/overview/lib.php` and
`lib/myprofilelib.php`. Dates and identifiers are invented. No credentials or SSO keys
are stored here. Deployment still needs read-only validation of the actual eders theme
and accounts from several educational programmes.
